title: Lesson 41 intensified and compound adjectival NNC review

groups.title: Reduplicative intensification
groups.proposal: Reuse the canonical VNC reduplication owner, distinguishing long-vowel intensity from glottal distributive or varietal plurality by typed operation and scope.
groups.readingJob: Show reduplication shape, scope, referent structure, and resulting adjectival reading.
groups.decisionSplit: The user chooses a reduplication formation or scope only when more than one licensed reading remains genuinely open.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not infer reduplication history from a repeated-looking string or make Canvas examples a stem list.

groups.title: Compound-matrix intensification
groups.proposal: Build intensified adjectival nounstems through the ordinary compound-NNC owner, preserving typed embed and matrix Results, class, order, and internal expansion facts.
groups.readingJob: Show embed, matrix, class, compound order, expansion, and intensity contribution.
groups.decisionSplit: Only a real embed, matrix, bracketing, or licensed expansion alternative is selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not create a special intensifier engine or derive matrix meaning from English translation.

groups.title: Affective and metaphorical intensification
groups.proposal: Reuse the affective-NNC owner for pōl, pil, tōn, and tzin matrices, retaining their typed intensity contribution and keeping metaphor or simile as interpretation rather than route authority.
groups.readingJob: Show the matrix, its augmentative or diminutive contribution, retained Source, and any metaphorical reading.
groups.decisionSplit: The matrix or reading is selectable only where the owner exposes a genuine semantic alternative.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not let metaphor, translation, or lexical frequency authorize morphology.

groups.title: Incorporated-adverb and supplementation Sources
groups.proposal: Preserve the canonical nominal-embed VNC and supplementation histories, including same-entity versus different-entity reference, while keeping the embed outside subject authority.
groups.readingJob: Show the embedded role, reference relation, matrix authority, and translation-perspective reversal.
groups.decisionSplit: Reference subtype or adverb role appears only when it changes the licensed Source relation.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not assign grammatical roles from English word order or a translated possessor.

groups.title: Incorporated complement, object, and patientive histories
groups.proposal: Keep incorporated complement, incorporated object, passive-adverbial, and patientive Source histories distinct even when their visible adjectival Results coincide.
groups.readingJob: Show the exact incorporated or nonactive Source history, patientive Result, participant roles, and adjectival continuation.
groups.decisionSplit: A Source-history choice appears only when morphology and context leave more than one licensed analysis open.
groups.controlPolicy: Never choose impersonal, passive, or patientive history from surface morphology alone.

groups.title: Compound NNC to denominal VNC to preterit-agentive function
groups.proposal: Preserve the ordered compound-NNC to denominal-ti VNC to preterit-agentive NNC chain, with each canonical owner issuing its own typed Result before adjectival use.
groups.readingJob: Show every typed unit, operation, exact handoff, and final adjectival function.
groups.decisionSplit: Only a genuinely open denominal operation or final modification relation is selectable.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not flatten the chain into a nounstem string or infer it from the final ending.

groups.title: Adjectival and numeral compound embeds
groups.proposal: Admit exact ordinary, possessive, preterit-agentive, and numeral NNC Results as typed compound embeds while preserving single-nucleus compound structure.
groups.readingJob: Show the exact embed Result, matrix authority, compound bracketing, and single-nucleus Result.
groups.decisionSplit: Embed role, possessor orientation, or bracketing is selectable only when the owner exposes a real alternative.
groups.controlPolicy: Do not confuse single-nucleus compound embedding with the multiple-nucleus structures of Lessons 42 and 43.
